tools.name: context_pack
tools.title: Build Kyro context pack
tools.description: Return the minimal routing/task context an agent should load for a Kyro scope. Use before resuming work or executing a task.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

task_id.description: Optional active sprint task id. Empty string means handoff.nextTaskId.

tools.name: doctor_artifacts
tools.title: Run Kyro artifact doctor
tools.description: Validate Kyro project and scope artifact shape, snapshots, narratives, and clarity markers. Use to check a scope is well-formed before planning or closing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: analyze_scope
tools.title: Analyze Kyro scope semantics
tools.description: Run semantic cross-checks for clarity, coverage, dependencies, debt, spec traceability, and project principles. Use to find blocking findings before executing or closing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

tools.name: scope_list
tools.title: List Kyro scopes
tools.description: List known Kyro scopes, their status, and which one is active. Use to discover scopes before targeting one.

tools.name: scope_inspect
tools.title: Inspect Kyro scope
tools.description: Return artifact doctor checks for one scope. Use to inspect a single scope by id.

tools.name: close_sprint
tools.title: Close active Kyro sprint
tools.description: Build or apply the deterministic lossless scope-checkpoint close plan. Use when every sprint task passed review and the sprint is ready to close. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: repair_scope
tools.title: Repair Kyro scope formatting
tools.description: Build or apply a sprint.json normalization plan. Use when doctor reports formatting drift. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: remediate_scope
tools.title: Remediate a closed Kyro scope
tools.description: Preview or apply a typed, append-only correction to a CLOSED scope whose live state no longer satisfies the contract. Use when doctor reports schema drift in a scope that was already closed, so its history must not be rewritten. Checkpoints, snapshots, narratives and ledger commitments are verified and never rewritten. Only registry operations are accepted (generic JSON Patch is rejected). Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

manifest.description: Path to a scope-remediation-manifest v1 or v3 document.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: remediate_canonicalize_prepare
tools.title: Prepare a debt canonicalization (read-only)
tools.description: Read one legacy debt record and report what canonicalization would need: its classification, the values already observed, the values still undecided, and the evidence behind each suggestion. Use when a debt cannot be repaired by origin alone because a canonical field is absent or invalid, or legacy-only keys such as detail/resolution/addedSprint must be retired. A suggested value is evidence, never authorization: only values you pass explicitly become canonical. With every value settled it returns a complete manifest for review. Read-only: it writes nothing, not even the manifest. Apply the reviewed manifest with remediate_scope.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

debt_id.description: Id of the debt record to canonicalize.

origin.description: Explicit sprint number the debt originated in. Omit to leave undecided.

priority.description: Explicit priority. Omit to leave undecided; no observation implies it.

target_sprint.description: Explicit target sprint. Omit to leave undecided; pass target_sprint_null:true for an explicit null.

target_sprint_null.description: Set true to decide targetSprint is explicitly null.

note.description: Explicit canonical note. Omit to leave undecided.

reason.description: Why this record is being canonicalized.

actor.description: Operator id recorded in the manifest provenance.

tools.name: remediate_canonicalize_preview
tools.title: Preview a debt canonicalization manifest (read-only)
tools.description: Re-check a canonicalization manifest against the state on disk: schema, protocol revision, scope binding, the whole-debt collection digest, preserved identity and lifecycle, and the legacy keys it retires. Use before handing a manifest on, or after the scope may have changed. The exact after-image is shown only when the manifest is complete and still true. Read-only: it writes nothing; apply the reviewed manifest with remediate_scope.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

manifest.description: Path to a scope-remediation-manifest v3 document carrying debt.canonicalize operations.

tools.name: recertify_scope
tools.title: Certify a remediated Kyro scope
tools.description: Preview or apply a certification recording that a remediated scope's corrected state was independently validated against named, re-verifiable evidence. Use after remediate, once the corrections have been checked. Every evidence digest is re-derived from the workspace; certification is refused when the chain does not replay to live state, when the chain head has moved, when evidence is empty, or when the verdict is not a pass. A certificate covers one chain head, so remediating again drops it. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

manifest.description: Path to a scope-certification-manifest v1 document.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: review_task
tools.title: Review a Kyro task (maker/checker)
tools.description: Run the deterministic maker/checker on a task and write its verdict. Use when a task is done and needs verification. Without confirm:true it returns the plan and writes nothing; a pass that fails the deterministic checks is refused.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

checked_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria the reviewer checked. Defaults to all on a pass.

waived_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria waived as "criterion::reason". Reason is required.

request_digest.description: Digest returned by a preview. A repeated applied digest is a no-op.

confirm.description: Required for mutation. Omit or false to return the dry-run plan without writing.

tools.name: trace_tail
tools.title: Read recent Kyro trace events
tools.description: Return the most recent append-only trace events for a scope. Use for observability or debugging a run. Read-only; trace never drives routing.

scope.description: Kyro scope id. Omit to use activeScope or the only existing scope.

limit.description: Max events to return (most recent). Defaults to 20.
